# ROM

> Builds and gates the Aleysian ROM estimate: a defensible cost and effort range around a scoping-app quote, plus the basis of estimate the client validates before deep scoping.

**What it does.** Build and gate the Aleysian ROM: a defensible cost and effort range around a scoping-app quote, plus the basis of estimate the client validates before deep scoping. Buyer-facing or deal-desk-facing.

**Use it when.** Asked for a ROM, rough order of magnitude, early pricing range, investment range, or ballpark for the quote, when a Q-number is paired with a range, sizing, or early-pricing request, or when a playbook tier needs its ROM artifact.

**Not for.** Do NOT use for scoping or quote creation (that is scoping-agent), the SOW (sow), the firm proposal (interactive-proposal), or a standalone ballpark-LOE request untied to a quote or playbook (say so and stop).
